How the SME5600D cleans your PCBA

Drag the 3D view to rotate it. Boards in the dual-layer basket are sprayed from all directions by 360° rotation rods, rinsed with DI water, then dried with hot air — all in one automated cycle.

01 · Load the basket

Place PCBA into the dual-layer cleaning basket (610 × 560 × 100 mm per layer) and press start.

02 · 360° spray wash

Upper, middle and lower rotation spray rods clean both sides at 30–80 PSI with water-based detergent.

03 · DI water rinse

DI water rinse repeats 3–5 times automatically to clear ionic residue.

04 · Hot-air dry

Hot air up to 99 °C dries the batch; clean boards come out ready for the line.

The hidden cost of residue and manual batch cleaning

Residue left on PCBA is reliability lost in the field

Every board with flux residue, and every slow manual clean, costs money. An automated batch cleaning machine changes that math.

Residue left on the board

Flux residue that is not fully removed causes leakage, corrosion and field failures.

Manual cleaning is slow

Hand-cleaning boards one by one ties up operators and gives inconsistent results.

Chemicals wasted

Uncontrolled washing consumes chemistry and water without predictable quality.

Hard-to-reach residues

Residues under components and in blind areas survive manual methods.

High-end products demand proof

Automotive and medical boards need documented ionic cleanliness.

Batch machines that damage boards

Aggressive cleaning damages boards and components when not controlled.

Installation guide

Install and commission the SME5600D

Reference procedure based on the SCM5600 operation and maintenance manual. Full documentation ships with the machine.

01 · Site preparation

Place the machine on a level floor with power, DI water supply, air (0.5–0.7 MPa, 400–600 L/min) and drainage at the position.

02 · Utilities

Connect power and DI water; connect the dry, oil-free compressed air supply.

03 · Pre-run check

Check nozzle angles, liquid tank for impurities, electric and pneumatic parts, and that pipes are connected firmly without leakage.

04 · Liquid & power on

Add cleaning liquid to the tanks, turn the main breaker on, then the power switch; verify the resistivity meter and pressures.

05 · Test cycle

Run a test batch through wash, rinse and dry; check the result, then release for production.

Technical evaluation FAQ

Questions buyers ask before ordering

What does the SME5600D clean?

It cleans flux residue and contaminants from assembled PCBA using a water-based detergent, DI water rinse and hot-air drying in a batch process.

How does the cleaning process work?

Place boards in the dual-layer basket and press start: upper, middle and lower 360° rotation spray rods wash at 30–80 PSI, then DI water rinse repeats 3–5 times, then hot air dries up to 99 °C — automatically.

What are the recommended process parameters?

Reference parameters: cleaning 10–20 minutes at 40–60 °C, rinse 1–2 minutes per cycle for 3–5 cycles, drying 20–30 minutes up to 99 °C.

What size boards fit the basket?

The dual-layer cleaning basket is 610 × 560 × 100 mm per layer, giving two layers of batch capacity per cycle.

Is it energy efficient?

Yes — the SME5600D is designed as an energy-saving, environmental protection machine with a sealed cleaning room, 0.22 µm liquid filtration and controlled chemistry use.

How do I get a price and delivery time?

Email info@smthelp.com or WhatsApp +86 136 0256 2576 with your board details, flux types and batch volume. Quotation and delivery schedule are provided after technical confirmation — typically the same working day.
